name: @postgear/media
description: The Python media service (FastAPI and a Temporal worker on postgear-media-py). Scripts call uv.

scripts.dev: node scripts/run-uv.js --optional run --env-file ../../.env uvicorn postgear_media.main:app --reload --reload-dir src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8100
scripts.lint: node scripts/run-uv.js run ruff check . && node scripts/run-uv.js run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:fix: node scripts/run-uv.js run ruff check --fix . && node scripts/run-uv.js run ruff format .
scripts.listen-benchmark: node scripts/run-uv.js run --group ml python -m postgear_media.simulation.benchmark
